fullPassage:
Notice to Hilltop Apartment Residents
In accordance with fire safety regulations, it is essential to keep all hallways free of personal belongings such as bicycles, boxes, and small furniture. Hallways serve as critical evacuation routes during emergencies, and anything left there could block the way and pose serious safety risks. To ensure the safety of all residents, we request that any personal items placed in the hallways be removed by Monday, April 14th. Please note that not following this may result in penalties. We appreciate your cooperation in maintaining a safe environment.

questions.passage:
Notice to Hilltop Apartment Residents
In accordance with fire safety regulations, it is ①<u>essential</u> ②<u>keeping</u> all hallways ③<u>free</u> of personal ④<u>belongings</u> such as bicycles, boxes, and small furniture. Hallways serve as critical evacuation routes during emergencies, and anything left there could block the way and pose serious safety risks. To ensure the safety of all residents, we request that any personal items placed in the hallways be removed by Monday, April 14th. Please note that not following this may result in penalties. We appreciate your cooperation in maintaining a safe environment.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② keeping → to keep: 'it is essential to keep'에서 it은 가주어, to keep이 진주어. 동명사 keeping은 이 구문에 부적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ① essential(필수적인): 보어로 적절
❌ ② keeping → to keep: it is + 형용사 + to부정사 구문 ←정답
✅ ③ free: free of 형용사 적절
✅ ④ belongings: 명사 복수형 적절
det.tip: it is + 형용사 + to부정사: 가주어 it 구문

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:

❌ ③ leaving → left: 과거분사 후치수식 (anything left there = 거기 놓여진 것) ←정답

det.tip: 과거분사 후치수식: anything left there = 거기에 남겨진 어떤 것이든

det.korean: ③ is removed → be removed: 'we request that...be removed'에서 request + that절은 당위/요구의 동사로, that절에 동사원형(be)이 와야 함 (가정법 현재).

det.tip: 요구·제안·명령 동사(request/suggest/insist) + that + S + 동사원형

Notice to Hilltop Apartment Residents
In accordance with fire safety regulations, it is essential to keep all hallways free of personal belongings such as bicycles, boxes, and small furniture. Hallways serve as critical evacuation routes during emergencies, and anything left there could block the way and pose serious safety risks. To ensure the safety of all residents, we request that any personal items placed in the hallways be removed by Monday, April 14th. Please note that not following this may result in penalties. We appreciate your cooperation in maintaining a safe environment.
